title: Legend
description: The key beside a chart: a Swatch and a label per series in series order, with an optional figure after each. The caller passes the same var(--juni-…) expressions the chart's bands wear, so the key cannot drift from the plot.

anatomy.description: A ul with data-slot="legend": a wrapping row of items with no list styling.
A li holding the Swatch, the label in text-sm bark-800 and, when given, the value in mono text-sm bark-700.

usage: Order the items as the chart stacks or ranks its series; the first band is categorical-0.
Pass value to turn the legend into a readout: the series' total at rest, the hovered point's figure while the pointer is on the chart.
A chart with one series needs no legend; its title says what it is.
